messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend
Bengaluru

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Mohd Azmaan
mohd azmaan... solid name. where you working these days?
nah nah, i meant which company? like are you at a startup, big tech, service company... where's the day job?
Yes
I work in Flipkart but as a FTC

flipkart as FTC... so you're in the contract zone, not the permanent party yet. that's the hustle right there.

found you on linkedin - mohd azmaan at flipkart. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/mohd-azmaan-31a155213

engineering at flipkart... building the backbone that keeps india shopping. ftc life is tough though - all the work, none of the equity drama. what made you take the contract route instead of going permanent somewhere?
Its the role that i took just after my b.tech. job market was very brutal at that time. So i decided to go with it

ah the post-covid fresh grad reality check... when companies were "pausing hiring" but still needed work done. smart move taking what was available instead of sitting idle. flipkart ftc beats unemployment any day.

how long you been working total?
2.8 years
2.8 years and still contract... time to level up. what kind of role you looking for next?
Sde1 or sde2 role in backend
backend sde1/sde2... that's the sweet spot for your experience. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Any place
2.8 years + backend engineering + sde1/sde2 + open to anywhere... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yeah

Yeah
  Ok

looks like you're already in the system legend! my bad - thought this was round one but you're already locked and loaded.

you should be getting those backend roles sliding into your chat. keep that hustle going at flipkart while we line up something permanent for you.

the contract life ends when we find you the right permanent spot. let's make it happen.
Yes i am excited

that's the energy we need. keep that excitement - you're building serious experience at flipkart while we hunt for the right permanent spot.

when something good comes through, you'll know.
Ok

perfect. you're set up and ready to roll. when my team sends something that fits your backend engineering profile, you'll be the first to know.

keep crushing it at flipkart in the meantime.
Do you need my cv to match job with my requirement

nah, your linkedin gives me enough to work with for now. if a role needs a CV, i'll ask you to upload it directly to the company's portal when you apply.

keep your resume updated though - you never know when the perfect opportunity shows up.

Ok
  Ok

got it. you're all set - linkedin profile locked in, preferences noted, and ready for backend roles.

when something good comes through, you'll see it.

hey, nike's hiring a software engineer i in bangalore

they want 1+ years experience, backend with node/python, cloud-native dev

could be a solid move from flipkart ftc to nike permanent

nike has a software engineer opening in bengaluru
